description: Set the enabled subnet routes for a device. Replaces all currently enabled routes — pass the full list of routes you want enabled.

deviceId.description: The device ID. nodeId from tailscale_list_devices (e.g. nPM2KNuedB21DEVEL); numeric id ok; not the nodeKey.

routes.description: Full list of CIDR routes to enable (e.g. ['10.0.0.0/24', '192.168.1.0/24']). Replaces existing enabled routes.

name: tailscale_set_device_routes
title: Set device routes
